references.inspection: Opened the actual local original and Commons page. Leafless oblique view shows the red-brick front and east return, arched windows, decorative courses, stone plinth and entrances. Branches, trunks and street objects still occlude some pixels.
limitations: The 2017 photograph is older than the August 2024 Street View survey; resolve changed entrances and street furniture against the newer visual survey.
The photo is a reference, not a measured elevation or source of building dimensions.
No reference pixels have been applied. Any future pixel derivative must retain attribution, identify edits and use CC BY-SA 4.0 or a compatible license.
Google Street View pixels are not copied into game assets.

references.title: Bulevardin Mallasmakasiini.jpg
references.author: Arkkipuudeli
references.attribution: Bulevardin Mallasmakasiini by Arkkipuudeli, 11 July 2011, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0
references.providedBy: Approved browser download into user workspace data; confirmed by user
references.inspection: Opened original local image and Commons page. Opposite angle clearly shows western three lower bay axes, paired rectangular upper windows, small upper arched openings, two arched full-height rows, brick corbels and stringcourses, stone base and small arched basement windows. Two front entrance canopies are visible farther east. Foreground crowns obscure central and eastern upper architecture.
limitations: 2011 capture is historical; use as architectural corroboration and licensed donor only with changes checked against 2017/2024 references.
No source pixels applied to production yet.
